results.description: sim.js loads in Node and exports createSim, step, PARAMS
Builder's PARAMS equal the Designer's spec params (Designer output reached the Builder)
createSim returns the contract state shape and is JSON-serialisable
Distance covered in 1 s is equal in all eight directions (within 1%) and travels the way the input points
After accelerating, speed equals spec runSpeed in cardinal and diagonal directions (within 2%)
Lunge distance is equal in all eight directions (within 1%) and equals spec lungeDistance (within 2%)
Direction input during a lunge does not change its path
A missed lunge is followed by a recovery period with no movement, then control returns
Same seed and same inputs give an identical state after 30 s
An undetected sedan cruises left to right with no route chevron, leaves, and another appears
A dummy standing in the lane is detected (chevron appears), the route locks at commitment, brake lights show while slowing, and the sedan swerves past without contact
After commitment, moving the dummy does not change the locked route (the bait works)
A front impact reduces health and adds score exactly once per contact episode
Staying in contact does not apply damage every frame
Contact with the rear of the car gives no damage and no score
Repeated front impacts destroy the body once, then a fresh body with full health appears
results.detail: destroyed after 2 cruise-speed front impacts (GDD provisional target: 2)

results.description: sim.js uses no Math.random, timers, clock or DOM
index.html has a canvas, loads sim.js, handles the keyboard and makes no network requests
